pages.text: Nearly every creature and realm has dishes of its own: $(l)Alex's Delight$(), $(l)Nether's Delight$() and its $(l:food/addons#blackstone_stove)Blackstone Stove$(/l), $(l)Ender's Delight$(), $(l)Ocean's Delight$(), $(l)Ice and Fire Delight$(), $(l)Twilight's Flavors & Delight$(), and more.
